title: Paper edit
description: The complete plan for the cut, written before any clip is placed. Once this exists, assembly is mechanical: every entry maps to one add_clips entry. Produced by the orchestrator from the merged shot log plus the beat map.

fps.description: Project fps, from get_timeline. Every frame number below assumes it.

bpm.description: From detect_beats. Verify against observed downbeat spacing before trusting it.

startFrame.description: Lay the music at 0 so every beat frame is round(beatSeconds * fps).

downbeatFrames.description: round(downbeatSeconds * fps) for each downbeat. Derived from absolute beat times, never accumulated.

sections.description: The energy curve, in musical sections rather than seconds.

name.description: hook, build, drop, sustain, breakdown, peak, resolve

cutLengthBars.description: Nominal hold for this section: 0.5, 1, 2 or 4 bars. Vary around it — do not make every cut identical.

treatment.description: Section-wide look or motion note, e.g. 'punch-in on every downbeat', 'slow-mo, no effects'.

slots.description: The shot list, in timeline order. One entry per cut.

startFrame.description: Timeline frame. Must equal a downbeat frame unless the entry is a deliberate off-beat cut.

endFrame.description: Exclusive. Must equal the next slot's startFrame — no gaps, no overlaps on the same track.

sourceIn.description: Source seconds, from the shot log select.

why.description: One line: why this shot, here. If it cannot be justified, the slot is filler — find a better shot.

treatment.description: Planned polish, applied only after the cut is locked: punch-in, speed-ramp, whip-in, flash-out, slow-mo, grid, freeze.

audioPunch.description: Present when this shot's diegetic audio should come up under the music.

coverage.description: Filled after the slots are chosen, to prove nothing is missing.

people.description: Appearances per person. A zero is a bug in the edit, not in the footage.

unusedHeroes.description: hero-verdict selects that did not make the cut. Justify each or place it.
